sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) Parliament may enact a law providing for: (a) the establishment of a Contingencies Fund and authorizing the President, or a Minister appointed by the President for that purpose, to make advances from that Fund to meet urgent and unforeseen expenditure for which no provision has been made; and (b) authorizing the President, or such Minister, to use money specifically appropriated for another purpose to meet urgent and unforeseen expenditure of the kind described in paragraph (a). (2) Where money has been advanced from the Contingencies Fund or money specifically appropriated for another purpose has been used to meet urgent and unforeseen expenditure, supplementary estimates shall be laid before Parliament and, after approval, the Appropriation Bill introduced to authorize that supplementary expenditure shall ensure that any money advanced from the Contingencies Fund is repaid to that Fund from the sums appropriated by that Bill.
